question: Prabha Atre, who received the Padma Vibhushan Award 2022, belongs to which Gharana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kirana gharana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Prabha Atre** is a renowned Indian classical vocalist who belongs to the **Kirana gharana**.
 
• The **Kirana gharana** is known for its emphasis on perfect pitch (sur) and intricate note patterns (taan).
 
• Prabha Atre has been a significant figure in Indian classical music and has contributed extensively to the Kirana gharana's repertoire.
 
• She has received numerous awards and accolades, including the **Padma Vibhushan** in 2022, which is India's second-highest civilian award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gharana**

 
 
• A gharana is a system of social organization linking musicians or dancers by lineage or apprenticeship, and by adherence to a particular musical style.
 
• The term "gharana" comes from the Hindi word "ghar," which means "house" and refers to a family tradition.
 
• Each gharana has its own distinct features and styles that differentiate it from others.
 
• The concept of gharana is pivotal in the Indian classical music tradition, playing a crucial role in preserving the unique characteristics of different musical styles.
 
 
 
• **Kirana Gharana**
 
 
• The Kirana gharana is one of the most prominent gharanas in Hindustani classical music.
 
• It was founded in the 19th century by Ustad Abdul Karim Khan and Ustad Abdul Wahid Khan.
 
• The gharana is named after the town of Kirana in Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• The Kirana gharana is renowned for its emphasis on the development and elaboration of notes and the emotional expression of ragas.
 
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan**
 
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest civilian award in India, after the Bharat Ratna.
 
• It is awarded to recognize exceptional and distinguished service in any field, including government service, arts, literature, science, and public affairs.
 
• The award was instituted in 1954 and is conferred by the President of India.
 
• Recipients of the Padma Vibhushan are announced annually on Republic Day (26th January).
